re-kreation.description: to create again, renew, or rebuild something
examples: The recreation of the ancient city took many years.
The park offers many forms of recreation for families.

boed.description: bent into a curved shape due to pressure, weight, or stress
examples: The heavy snow bowed the branches of the tree.

boughed.description: inclined the head or body in a gesture of respect, greeting, or submission
examples: He bowed to the audience after his performance. He has bowed to the audience.
They plan to live in the countryside

prezent.description: to introduce, show, or formally offer

ro.description: a line or series of things

teer.description: a drop from the eye when crying

pollish.description: to make smooth and shiny by rubbing

inva lid.description: a person who is disabled or infirm

elaborayt.description: to develop or explain in detail

wind.description: moving air; a current of air

whined.description: to coil, turn, or bring to a close

examples: The hotel serves an excellent breakfast buffet.

krooked.description: past tense: bent a body part into a curve or hook
examples: He crooked his finger to beckon the waiter.
She crooked her arm around his neck.
A crooked path wound through the woods.

dog ed.description: Past tense and past participle of the verb dog
examples: The paparazzi dogged the celebrity's every move as she left the restaurant.

minit.description: unit of time or meeting record
examples: The secretary wrote the meeting minutes.
